rules: Keep the volume leg raw or rank-transformed inside a TS_CORR against $high - $low: a TS_STD($volume, 5) leg screened at |t| 0.11 and a TS_DELTA($dollar_volume, 63) leg at 0.70, while the raw-leg corr accepted at 3.750. Dispersion and difference stats on that leg kill the signal.

CS_RANK(fundamental) minus a price/range rank took the round's top four fitnesses (4.839, 4.475, 3.750, 1.918). Keep the chassis, but the corr-shaped price legs off $roe are now spent: window moves (15 to 105) and volume-leg renormalisation still landed at rho 0.867 and 0.889. Use extremum-position or summed-range legs instead.

Do not multiply $roa or $roe by a price leg: CS_ZSCORE($roa) * a fresh range/dollar-volume rank hit rho 0.913 against bare RANK($roa). The same product shape with $accrual_gap accepted at 3.787, so pick a fundamental whose bare level is not already an archive member.

Stop choosing tiny archive members as crossover parents. Four proposals died on crossover_not_a_fusion against $volume or CS_RANK($roe) - CS_RANK($volume); those parents have no donatable 3-node subtree, so any child is impossible by construction.

Short-window-over-long-window ratios of the same TS_STD are the productive fresh price leg: TS_STD($volume, 5)/TS_STD($volume, 42) carried 3.787, a $dollar_volume mean/sum term structure 1.038, and a SIGN of a 63-vs-5-day return-vol difference 2.059.

Operator, field and algebra swaps inside a live kernel do not clear the correlation gate: TS_STD for TS_MEAN of $high - $low at the same window hit 0.972, $operating_margin for $leverage inside a 63-day delta 0.801, and rearranging a range-over-dollar-volume ratio 0.909. Change the kernel, not its spelling.
Count a condition rather than masking with it: COUNT($volume > TS_MEAN($volume, 42), 10) accepted at 1.274, while IF_ELSE gating $high - $low on the same volume condition diluted to |t| 0.37.

Correlating a field against its own cross-sectional demeaning is filler: the two such accepts scored 0.706 and 0.341, the round's weakest, and they now occupy archive slots that will gate later volume-corr work.
